line: Congratulations!
action: Cold open at his front door: Ebo throws his arms up, beaming, straight to camera.

line: You've decided you want to stay poor.
action: Points straight at us. Slight push.

line: And lucky for you, it's actually pretty easy.
action: Easy shrug.

line: You don't need a degree.
action: Insert: the framed degree on his hallway wall gets a red NOT NEEDED stamp (stamp snaps on).

line: You don't need experience.
action: Ebo holds up a completely blank CV.

line: You don't even need to leave your house.
action: Hard cut home: Ebo already on the couch. Pull out to show the whole cosy room.

line: All you need is a comfortable couch,
action: Insert: the couch cushion sinking.

line: a smartphone,
action: Insert: the phone glowing in his hand.

line: and an extraordinary ability to make terrible decisions.
action: Ebo proudly opens a giant bag of chips for breakfast. Snap-zoom on the grin.

line: Now, obviously, life isn't fair. Some people start with way more opportunities than others.
action: Sincere for a beat. Slow sideways drift.

line: But if your goal is to make your situation even worse…
action: The grin creeps back. Push in.

line: Oh boy. Have I got some tips for you.
action: Snap-zoom: wide eyes, rubbing hands.

line: Welcome to the ultimate guide to staying broke.
action: Title card in the dark room; Ebo presents it. Slow push.
text: THE ULTIMATE GUIDE TO STAYING BROKE (title card)

line: Watch television.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / WATCH TV ALL DAY

line: Lots of television.
action: Reverse angle, establishing: over the couch back — the back of Ebo's head, the TV glowing ahead of him.

line: And when I say lots, I mean LOTS.
action: The TV's point of view: start on his face, eyes glued to the screen (to us); on "LOTS" pull out fast.

line: The average person already watches almost three hours a day.
action: Ebo states the fact like a news anchor.

line: Rookie numbers.
action: Snap-zoom: unimpressed.

line: Wake up in the morning?
action: Bedroom, morning: Ebo in bed, eyes snap open.

line: Television.
action: Remote already in hand, clicks.

line: Eating breakfast?
action: Kitchen: Ebo at the table, cereal.

line: Television.
action: Whip-pan along his eyeline to the kitchen TV.

line: Supposed to be working on something important?
action: Desk, laptop open: a real deadline. Ebo looks determined…

line: You guessed it.
action: …his eyes slide sideways.

line: Television!
action: Whip to the living room: Ebo dives onto the couch.

line: And if you're feeling particularly ambitious, switch to your phone.
action: TV still on (camera side), phone comes out too: double screens.

line: Because why waste eight hours watching television
action: Insert: the TV screen.

line: when you can waste twelve hours scrolling through videos of strangers doing absolutely nothing?
action: Insert: the phone feed scrolling, held frames.

line: Remember, the goal isn't to relax. Relaxing is perfectly normal.
action: Finger up, making a point.

line: The goal is to make sure entertainment becomes your entire personality.
action: Push in on "entire personality".

line: And whatever you do… never ask yourself where all that time went.
action: Night now, same couch, same pose. Slow pull-out.

line: I certainly don't.
action: Eyes still on the screen (on us), a tiny smirk.

line: Avoid hobbies.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / NO HOBBIES

line: Especially hobbies that teach you something.
action: Mock horror.

line: Drawing? Too much effort.
action: An empty easel. Ebo looks at it and shrugs.

line: Writing? Sounds exhausting.
action: A blank notebook. Ebo slumps just looking at it.

line: Learning to code?
action: Insert: lines of code on the laptop.

line: Absolutely disgusting.
action: Snap-zoom: full disgust face.

line: Why would you spend your free time developing a skill
action: Reasoning with us.

line: when you could spend twelve hours watching someone else develop theirs?
action: Ebo on the couch, watching a painting video on his phone, entranced. Push to the phone.

line: And please, don't even think about trying something new.
action: Wagging a finger at us.

line: You might discover you're actually good at it.
action: Fantasy: Ebo tries painting… and it's good. He's shocked.

line: And then what?
action: Alarmed.

line: You might improve.
action: Snap-zoom 1.

line: You might meet interesting people.
action: Snap-zoom 2 (closer).

line: You might even find an opportunity.
action: Snap-zoom 3 (closest): a gasp, hand over his mouth.

line: Terrifying.
action: Smash cut wide: Ebo alone in the dark, tiny and scared.

line: Better to stay exactly where you are.
action: Back on the couch, relieved.

line: Never pursue anything you care about.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / NO PASSION

line: Have a dream?
action: Bedroom, night: Ebo asleep, smiling.

line: Ignore it.
action: Eyes snap open, flat face, rolls over.

line: Got an idea?
action: Desk: Ebo slaps a sticky note on the wall, inspired.

line: Forget it.
action: The note has slid down the wall. Ebo walks off.

line: Want to start a project?
action: Ebo at the desk, cracking his knuckles.

line: Tell yourself you'll do it next Monday.
action: Insert: he writes MONDAY on the desk calendar.

line: And when Monday comes…
action: Same insert: the page flips. It's Monday.

line: well, obviously, you meant next Monday.
action: Ebo shrugs and flips the page again.

line: This is called strategic procrastination. Very advanced stuff.
action: Hand on chin, very pleased with himself.

line: Eventually, you'll become so good at planning things that you'll never actually have to do anything.
action: Night: a wall FULL of sticky notes. Pull out to reveal it all.

line: You'll have seventeen unfinished ideas,
action: Pan across the seventeen notes.

line: forty motivational screenshots,
action: Insert: the phone gallery, grid of quote screenshots.

line: and absolutely nothing to show for them.
action: Ebo, alone at the empty desk under the wall of notes.

line: But hey… at least your phone gallery looks inspirational.
action: He holds the gallery up proudly. Push in.

line: Stay comfortable. At all costs.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / COMFORT ZONE

line: Never apply for a better opportunity.
action: Insert: a job post, thumb hovering over APPLY.

line: What if they reject you?
action: Imagined: a REJECTED letter appears in his hand. He flinches.

line: Never try learning something difficult.
action: Desk: a hard tutorial on the laptop.

line: What if you fail?
action: He slams the laptop shut. Snap-zoom.

line: And definitely never ask questions.
action: Office: Ebo half-raises his hand…

line: What if somebody thinks you're stupid?
action: …and lowers it slowly. Push in.

line: See, the trick is to avoid every situation where you might feel uncomfortable.
action: Explaining.

line: That way, you'll never experience embarrassment.
action: Ticks it off on a finger.

line: Or rejection.
action: Jump cut closer.

line: Or failure.
action: Jump cut closer again.

line: Of course, you might also miss opportunities to grow.
action: Ebo walks right past the front door (an open opportunity) without looking.

line: But that's a small price to pay for never having to try.
action: Cheerful shrug.

line: Besides… your comfort zone has snacks.
action: From Ebo munching, pull out: he's inside a blanket fort labelled COMFORT ZONE, piled with snacks.

line: Wait for a miracle.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / WAIT FOR MAGIC

line: Don't make a plan.
action: He closes a blank planner.

line: Don't build useful skills.
action: Laptop pushed away.

line: Don't take action.
action: He just sits down. (three matching cuts, same framing)

line: Just sit there and wait for the universe to recognize your incredible potential.
action: Ebo lies on the living-room floor, arms out, candles lit, waiting. Very slow push-in.

line: Maybe a millionaire will randomly knock on your door.
action: Ebo waits by the front door, hopeful.

line: Maybe someone will offer you your dream job while you're sleeping.
action: Asleep, dreaming of a HIRED letter.

line: Maybe a suitcase full of money will fall from the sky.
action: Tilt down from a suitcase of cash in the sky to Ebo waiting under it, arms out. (It never lands.)

line: The odds of winning a big lottery jackpot are about one in three hundred million.
action: The real number, deadpan.

line: Practically guaranteed.
action: Snap-zoom: big fake grin.

line: And if none of those things happen? Don't worry. Just keep waiting.
action: Back at the door: still waiting, slumped. No knock.

line: After all, nothing says financial strategy quite like staring at the ceiling and hoping for the best.
action: From his face, staring up, pull all the way out: tiny Ebo on the floor.

line: And finally… blame everybody.
action: Chapter card: title slams in on the left, Ebo on the right. Slow push-in.
text: HOW TO STAY BROKE / BLAME EVERYONE

line: Your boss.
action: Office: Ebo points off right.

line: Your parents.
action: Whip into the living room, pointing left.

line: Your friends.
action: Whip into the kitchen, pointing right.

line: The government.
action: Kitchen, pointing at the ceiling.

line: The weather.
action: At the window, pointing at the rain.

line: That guy who looked at you funny in 2017.
action: Slow, intense push-in on narrowed eyes. Long hold.

line: Everybody!
action: Smash cut wide: Ebo pointing everywhere at once in the dark room.

line: Now, some problems really are outside your control.
action: Sincere beat.

line: But that's no reason to examine the things you actually can change.
action: Back to sarcasm. Push in.

line: Because the moment you take responsibility for one small decision…
action: Leaning in, whispering.

line: you might have to do something about it.
action: Snap-zoom: horror, hands on his cheeks.

line: And we certainly can't have that.
action: Back on the couch, all better.

line: So there you have it. Six simple habits that can help keep you stuck.
action: Dark room: wrapping up.

line: Of course, avoiding them won't magically make you rich. But changing even one might help you move forward.
action: Sincere and warm. Slow push.

line: Turn off the TV for one hour.
action: Recap montage (each habit reversed). Reverse angle: the TV is off, Ebo still facing it.

line: Pick one hobby.
action: Ebo painting.

line: Start the Monday project today.
action: Typing on the laptop; the sticky wall is gone.

line: Do one scary thing a week.
action: Hand up high in the office.

line: Make your own luck.
action: Ebo opens the front door himself and steps out.

line: And own what you can control.
action: Nod to camera.

line: Now, if you'll excuse me…
action: Ebo fast-walks off frame right; the camera follows.

line: I've got seventeen episodes of a show to finish.
action: The reveal, reverse angle: right back on the couch, TV on. Push in over his shoulder.

line: For research purposes, obviously.
action: The TV's point of view: smirk. Snap-zoom.

line: Subscribe for more.
action: End card.
text: SUBSCRIBE button · EBO TEACHES MONEY · EP 4
